about: Every poll in Wikipedia's polling tables for the 2022-11-01 election, from the day after the previous election (2021-03-23) to the day before the vote, newest first: 156 polls by 16 pollsters (25 by Shlomo Filber's firms). The outgoing Knesset was dissolved on 2022-06-30 (94 polls since). Same schema as the 28-day files in data/, with the same lists, blocs, agreements and result as data/2022-11.json; parties that merged, split or withdrew during the campaign have their own ids, listed in otherLists (`into` names the final list they merged into). Built by scripts/forecast/backtest/build-data-full.py; memo docs/research/polls-method/round2/D1-data-full.md.
blocNote: Netanyahu bloc as calibration.json counts it for 2022: Likud, Shas, UTJ, Religious Zionism–Otzma. The Jewish Home (Shaked, uncommitted, failed) is 'mid'. The fringe Pirates–Yesh Kivun agreement is omitted (neither list is polled).
